name: setup-manaflow-ai-astrolabe-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces: theme files for color (Astrolabe, dark, the default; Astrolabe Dawn), settings for an airy serif chat and Markdown viewer and a sectioned sidebar, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens that frames the prompt and cards in gold hairlines with small corners, and a customize view for a titled hover card and quiet sidebar rows. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Astrolabe sidebar" },
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Astrolabe's hover card and sidebar rows: a titled card with the task in full, medium names and a thin arc while work runs.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}

// Astrolabe Dawn: the same frames at first light: ivory parchment, navy ink, a bronze accent deep
// enough to read as text on the page, and a sidebar a step warmer.

  "description": "Ivory parchment, navy ink, bronze hairlines.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Light",
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "colors": { "background": "#f8f4ea", "foreground": "#14203a", "selection": "#e6dcc2", "accent": "#8a6418" },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  "ghostty": [
    "background = #f8f4ea",
    "foreground = #14203a",
    "cursor-color = #8a6418",
    "cursor-text = #f8f4ea",
    "selection-background = #e6dcc2",
    "selection-foreground = #14203a",
    "palette = 0=#14203a",
    "palette = 1=#a8352a",
    "palette = 2=#2f6b3c",
    "palette = 3=#8a6418",
    "palette = 4=#24509a",
    "palette = 5=#7a3d8f",
    "palette = 6=#1f6b70",
    "palette = 7=#575f70",
    "palette = 8=#6a7080",
    "palette = 9=#9e3026",
    "palette = 10=#2a6236",
    "palette = 11=#7e5b14",
    "palette = 12=#204a8e",
    "palette = 13=#713885",
    "palette = 14=#1b6267",
    "palette = 15=#a09a8a"
  ],

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "none",

  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat-sidebar-line",
  "appearance.borders": "default",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "subtleTone",
  "appearance.focusIndicator": "tabs",
  "appearance.density": "comfortable",

  "appearance.metrics.titlebarHeight": 40,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarWidth": 260,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeight": 32,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 13,
  "appearance.metrics.tabStripHeight": 34,
  "appearance.metrics.tabFontSize": 12,

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#f0e9d8",

  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#f8f4ea",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#f8f4ea",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.color": "#f8f4ea",
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.color": "#d6c69c",
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.border": true,
  "sidebar.borderWidth": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "lines",

  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.animation": "animated",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#8a6418",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.thickness": 1.25,

  "appearance.colorTransition.enabled": true,
  "appearance.colorTransition.curve": "easeInOut",
  "appearance.colorTransition.duration": 240,
  "appearance.colorTransition.colorSpace": "oklab",
  "appearance.colorTransition.reduceMotion": "instant"

files.themes/astrolabe.json:
// Astrolabe: deep navy with a cool ink sidebar a shade darker, warm ivory text, and old gold as
// the accent (Send, links, the selected row, the frames the stylesheet draws). Hairline edges,
// flat chrome with a sidebar line, and a slow, soft glow for work in progress.
{
  "name": "Astrolabe",
  "description": "Deep navy, ivory text, old-gold hairlines and a soft gold glow.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Dark",
  // The window, sidebar and pages take that theme too, over an App Theme of your own.
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "colors": { "background": "#0e1628", "foreground": "#efe8d8", "selection": "#2a3550", "accent": "#d4af5f" },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  "ghostty": [
    "background = #0e1628",
    "foreground = #efe8d8",
    "cursor-color = #d4af5f",
    "cursor-text = #0e1628",
    "selection-background = #2a3550",
    "selection-foreground = #efe8d8",
    "palette = 0=#18223a",
    "palette = 1=#e07a6e",
    "palette = 2=#8fc59a",
    "palette = 3=#d4af5f",
    "palette = 4=#7fa3e0",
    "palette = 5=#c49ad8",
    "palette = 6=#7cc4c8",
    "palette = 7=#cfc7b4",
    "palette = 8=#5b6680",
    "palette = 9=#f0958a",
    "palette = 10=#a8d8b1",
    "palette = 11=#e6c67e",
    "palette = 12=#9dbbef",
    "palette = 13=#d6b3e6",
    "palette = 14=#9ad7da",
    "palette = 15=#fbf6ea"
  ],

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "none",

  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat-sidebar-line",
  "appearance.borders": "default",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "subtleTone",
  "appearance.focusIndicator": "tabs",
  "appearance.density": "comfortable",

  "appearance.metrics.titlebarHeight": 40,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarWidth": 260,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeight": 32,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 13,
  "appearance.metrics.tabStripHeight": 34,
  "appearance.metrics.tabFontSize": 12,
  "appearance.metrics.dividerThickness": 1,

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#0a1120",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#0e1628",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#0e1628",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.color": "#0e1628",
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.color": "#5a4a2a",
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.border": true,
  "sidebar.borderWidth": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "lines",

  // Work in progress is a thin gold arc.
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.animation": "animated",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#d4af5f",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.thickness": 1.25,

  "appearance.colorTransition.enabled": true,
  "appearance.colorTransition.curve": "easeInOut",
  "appearance.colorTransition.duration": 240,
  "appearance.colorTransition.colorSpace": "oklab",
  "appearance.colorTransition.reduceMotion": "instant"
